div.head: Geþyncðo 6
div.ab: 7 gif mássere geþeah, þæt he ferde þrige ofer wíd sǽ be his agenum cræfte, se wæs þonne syððan þegenrihtes weorðe.
Et si massere ascenderet, ut ter magnum mare transfretaret per proprium negotium suum, fuit deinde taini dignus rectitudine.
And gif massere geþeah þæt he ferde þrige ofer widsæ be his agenum cræfte, se wæs þonne syððan þegenrihtes weorðe.
Und wenn ein Kaufmann [so] emporkam, dass er dreimal vermöge seiner eigenen Geschäftskraft übers offene Meer fuhr, der genoss dann fortan Thegnberechtigung.
And if a merchant prospered [so] that he crossed the open sea three times by his own means, he was thereafter entitled to thegn-right.
And if a trader prospered, that he crossed thrice the open sea at his own expense, he was then afterwards entitled to the rights of a thegn.]
And if a merchant prospered so that he fared three times over the open sea by his own means, he was afterward worthy of a thane’s rights.
